name: Nexron AI Chat
author: Nexron

sections.description:
Nexron AI Chat enhances your WooCommerce store with advanced chatbot functionality, allowing customers to find products quickly and efficiently. Powered by Nexron’s AI technology, this plugin provides an interactive shopping experience directly within your store. Nexron AI Chat connections to the Nexron AI servers to provide chat functionality.

Key Features:

  • AI-powered chatbot for product discovery
  • Indepth understanding og your stores products and their attributes
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce
  • Real-time product interactions
  • Easy setup and configuration
  • Requires a Nexron account to use the service

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the Nexron AI Chat plugin on your WordPress site.
  2. Connect the plugin to your Nexron account using the Nexron AI Chat dashboard on your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Configure the chatbot settings to match your store’s needs.
  4. The chatbot will assist customers in finding products based on their input and preferences.
  5. Integration with Nexron AI handles chat functionality. This integration ensures that shopppers are able to perform advance conversational searches against the store product inventory.
  6. The plugin sends certain product and store data to Nexron AI to provide chat functionality.

Important Links

  1. Nexron AI: https://www.nexron.ai
  2. Terms of Use: https://www.nexron.ai/assets/docs/Terms%20&%20Conditions.pdf
  3. Privacy Policy: https://www.nexron.ai/assets/docs/Privacy%20Policy.pdf

sections.installation:
1. Install the Plugin from the WordPress Marketplace or upload the nexron-ai-chat folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Nexron AI Chat settings page to configure the plugin and set up/sign into your Nexron account.
  4. Enter your Nexron account details and ensure you have sufficient credits to use the service.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Nexron account to use this plugin?

Yes, a Nexron account is required to use the Nexron AI Chat plugin. You will also need credits in your Nexron account to access the chatbot services.

How do I get a Nexron account?

You can sign up for a Nexron account on the Nexron AI Chat settings page on your WordPress website or alyternatively visit www.nexron.ai.

How do I configure the chatbot?

After activating the plugin, go to the Nexron AI Chat settings page in your WordPress admin dashboard. Enter your Nexron account details and configure the chatbot settings to match your store’s needs.

What happens if I run out of Nexron credits?

If you run out of credits, the chatbot functionality will be temporarily disabled until you purchase more credits through your Nexron account. Credits can be topped up at anytime.

What data does Nexron AI Chat Plugin send to Nexron AI?

The plugin may send product and store data to Nexron AI. This data is used for analysing and understanding the product inventory and store purpose.

Can I use the plugin without connecting to Nexron AI?

Features of Nexron AI Chat Plugin rely on Nexron AI services and will not function correctly if the service is not available or if you choose not to connect.
